answer: The wander is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vault. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
